purpose: Determine whether the nine localized S10 low-clearance route poses admit a nearby lateral x/y location with an automatically solved floor-following sensor z and unchanged 0.8m safety threshold.

approval.scope: One read-only S10 C08 local lateral-pose audit over 9 route poses x 21 x 21 x/y cells; zero inference, graph, training, C09/C10/M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续推进 after receiving the exact ±1m, 0.1m, 3969-cell local x/y plus floor-following-z audit proposal.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local read-only research audit of sealed generated assets.

sampling.rule: Retain all nine route-failure records including reverse-traversal repeats. Around each original sensor x/y evaluate offsets -1.0 through +1.0m at exact 0.1m spacing on both axes: 441 parameter cells per pose. At each cell cast one floor query ray, place the sensor 1.0m above that floor, then cast 720 world-horizontal and one down/up verification ray. Parameter cells are not independent samples.

teacher.source: No semantic teacher. Sealed mesh first-hit geometry defines floor-following z and horizontal/up/down distances.
teacher.valid_mask: Feasible iff the solved sensor pose has horizontal clearance >=0.8m, downward distance in [0.95,1.05]m, upward clearance >=0.8m and complete vertical evidence within 8m. A robust recommendation additionally requires membership in a four-neighbour component of at least three feasible cells.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Local diagnostic only; no trajectory is rewritten and no planner/model consumes the result.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only S10 C08 mesh and prior C08 audit CSV are opened; C09/C10/M-TARE remain unread.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D, 2,857,680 horizontal and 11,907 vertical rays; expected seconds to minutes.

evidence.machine_metrics: 3969-row candidate CSV; nine pose component summaries and five physical-group decisions.
evidence.complete_visual_review: One lateral-clearance heatmap figure per physical group with feasible cells, frozen pose and nearest robust recommendation.
evidence.failure_policy: Stop on hash/count/nonfinite accepted evidence/forbidden-read loss; do not stop when no robust feasible component exists because that is a valid diagnostic conclusion.
